name: flow-mcp
description: Build, check and run Flow discrete-event simulation models with your AI assistant, on your own computer.
long_description: Lets your assistant read Flow's model format, validate models with Flow's own validator, run them with Flow's simulation engine (several replications, with 95% confidence intervals and warnings about bottlenecks and overload) and save them as files you open in Flow with + New Model → Import a file. Everything runs on your computer; models are plain JSON files in one folder.

tools.name: flow_get_schema
tools.description: Flow's model format: generation protocol, common mistakes, and any section on request.

tools.name: flow_list_models
tools.description: List the model files in your Flow models folder.

tools.name: flow_read_model
tools.description: Read a model file, e.g. one exported from Flow.

tools.name: flow_validate_model
tools.description: Check a model with Flow's own validator.

tools.name: flow_run_model
tools.description: Run a model for several replications: results with 95% confidence intervals, routes, goals met or missed.

tools.name: flow_compare_models
tools.description: Compare two versions with the same random numbers: which differences are real, which could be chance.

tools.name: flow_run_over_time
tools.description: Queue lengths, utilisation and work in progress period by period.

tools.name: flow_save_model
tools.description: Save a model as a file Flow can import. Never overwrites by default.

models_folder.title: Flow models folder
models_folder.description: Where models are read from and saved to. Leave empty to use Documents/Flow models.
